comment: Whether the number of matching products is shown next to each filter option.
modal: When **Yes**, layered navigation shows a count of matching products beside each filter value. Can be set per store view.

comment: How price filter ranges are calculated — automatically or by a manual step.
modal: Chooses how price-filter buckets are built: automatically, or using a manual fixed step set in Default Price Navigation Step. Can be set per store view.

comment: The fixed price interval used to build price-filter ranges.
modal: The price interval for each price-filter range. Applies only when Price Navigation Step Calculation is set to Manual. Can be set per store view.
